_comment: Building-fact vocabulary (interface I7, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Silvan's address lookup produces these facts per address; Dimitar's extraction writes coverage conditions (applies_if / exempt_if) using ONLY these names, types and operators. Anything a rule needs that is not here (length of tenancy, household, lease terms) goes into tenant_conditions as plain text, never into a predicate. Semantics are three-valued: a comparison is true if every value in the fact's range satisfies it, false if none does, unknown if some do or the fact is null.

facts.name: built
facts.source: year_built from the CSV; year y becomes [y-01-01, y-12-31]. Stands in for certificate-of-occupancy date, so a cutoff inside the build year evaluates to unknown.
facts.null_means: year built missing (all Berkeley and San Diego rows, many NJ rows)

facts.name: units
facts.source: units from the CSV, else parsed from use_description ("5B-20U" -> 20, "APT 7-30 UNITS" -> 7..30, "(5+ units)" -> 5..null). Conflicting sources -> null plus a review flag.

facts.name: use_class
facts.value_type: one value or a list for 'in'
facts.source: mapped from use_code / use_description per dataset

facts.name: subsidised
facts.source: use_description ("SUBSD HOUSING", NJ "AFFORDABL") → true; no affordability code → unknown (null), never inferred false; false requires explicit supporting evidence; later HUD LIHTC / multifamily assisted lists (P1)
facts.null_means: not known: no explicit evidence establishes subsidy status

facts.name: owner_type
facts.value_type: one value or a list for 'in'
facts.source: never in the data (owner names excluded from the pack)
facts.null_means: always null; rules that depend only on it evaluate to unknown, unless another fact already decides (e.g. units >= 5 rules out a small-landlord exception)

facts.name: owner_occupied
facts.source: never set from data in the scored outputs; tax-exemption proxies appear as card notes only

special_nodes.meaning: Building age relative to the as-of date, computed from 'built' (e.g. California's cap exempts buildings under 15 years: {"age_years": {"op": "lt", "n": 15}} in exempt_if).
Another rule's result at the same address (e.g. a state rule that applies only where no local rent control applies). Evaluates to that rule's true / false / unknown.
A condition the extraction could not map to these facts. Always evaluates to unknown, never dropped.

example.unparsed: units with a rent-control exemption filing on record
